title: reject-deletion command payload

decidedBy.description: The deciding admin's oid, written to DeletionProposals.DecidedBy and Documents.HeldBy.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command reject-deletion (connectors design §13.3): deletes nothing, holds the proposed documents (Documents.HeldAt/HeldBy) and ends the run degraded with deletion.rejected. Dedup deletion:{runId}.
